steps: Search for dish soap from the header using keyboard Enter.
Observe a populated result grid with price, rating and fulfillment.
Apply Dawn brand and price-low sorting; verify query state remains in the URL.
Open Dawn Ultra detail and inspect description, ratings and fulfillment.
journeys.expected: Search, filters, sorting and detail deep links are deterministic and navigable.

steps: Select Fresh Rain variant and observe option label and price feedback.
Add one item to the local cart.
Review item, option, quantity and subtotal.
Continue to checkout review, enter ZIP 95829, and open review.
Verify place-order is disabled and no payment or submission control exists.
journeys.expected: A real local cart reaches a truthful safe review boundary with zero external effect.

steps: Change quantity from one to two and verify subtotal.
Refresh and verify quantity persists.
Remove the line and verify the empty-cart recovery state.
journeys.expected: Server-side cart quantity and removal mutations persist for one anonymous cart and remain isolated.

steps: Search zzzz-no-match-websitebench.
Verify zero result cards and explicit no-results copy.
Use Return to home or See all departments to recover.
journeys.expected: No false matches are rendered and both recovery links are local.

steps: Open checkout review with a populated cart.
Submit an empty and then an invalid ZIP.
Verify inline error and aria-invalid.
Correct to 95829 and reach review.
journeys.expected: Invalid input changes no order state and valid input reaches review only.

steps: Open All Departments.
Choose Household Essentials and inspect products.
Use breadcrumb or home navigation to return.
journeys.expected: Department and category alternatives to search are reachable.

steps: Tab to search, type with keyboard, and press Enter.
Open and dismiss the fulfillment popover with Escape and verify focus restoration.
Navigate results to detail and use Back and Forward.
Refresh and restart after adding one item; verify cart persistence.
Repeat key views at 390x844.
journeys.expected: Keyboard, history, refresh, responsive layout and server persistence work without nonlocal requests.

steps: Open Account from the header.
Verify the explicit out-of-scope notice.
Return without entering credentials.
journeys.expected: The clone never solicits credentials or claims an account action.

steps: Open an unknown deep link.
Verify HTTP 404 and branded recovery links.
Return to home.
journeys.expected: Unknown routes fail honestly and recover locally.
